name: GSC Wizard
description: Read Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster, and analytics data for connected properties.

methods.label: Sign in with GSC Wizard
methods.whenToUse: Use remote OAuth authorization for the GSC Wizard MCP.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect the GSC Wizard account and its authorized properties. Check site identity and date bounds before querying; review any URL submission or property-changing action separately.
warnings: Some tools may submit URLs or otherwise change external indexing state; review action details before use.
GSC Wizard connects multiple search and analytics providers; confirm the authorized property and action policy for each tool.

methods.label: Use a GSC Wizard MCP key
methods.whenToUse: Use a customer-created GSC Wizard MCP key in a Bearer header.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a key for the intended account and select the appropriate read or write permission during key creation. Verify each connected property before querying; review URL submission actions separately.
